root_cause.text: The vulnerability stems from `crypto_authenc_esn_create()` failing to validate the underlying ahash digest size, permitting invalid values between 1 and 3 bytes to establish an unsupported default authsize that results in out-of-bounds memory access.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description explicitly states `crypto_authenc_esn_create()` "copied auth->digestsize into inst->alg.maxauthsize without validating it," and the patch diff adds a guard clause `if (auth->digestsize > 0 && auth->digestsize < 4)` to reject these cases.
